title: Air filters
summary: Professional air filtration solutions for homes, offices and industrial spaces.
paragraphs: A ventilation or heat-recovery system makes it possible to control indoor air temperature and humidity, as well as airflow speed, pollution and other parameters. Air filters provide a significant reduction of pollution indoors and protect ventilation equipment from dust entering the unit. By regularly replacing filter components such as pocket filters or panel filters, HEPA filters or compact filters, the equipment is given a longer service life.
